Class MatchManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.network.server.matches.MatchManager
public class MatchManager extends Object
Manages the list of active game matches and tracks globally logged-in users. This class acts as a manager, handling user sessions across the server and ensuring matches are safely created, joined, and automatically cleaned up once finished.
